verdict_reason: Multiple high-severity findings exist but are pre-existing tech debt, not Phase 1 regressions. Phase 1 convergence criteria all pass. Proceed with caveats.

findings.title: Cypher injection via unsanitized entityType in graph queries
findings.description: entityType prop is interpolated directly into Cypher query strings without validation. JSON.stringify protects other params but entityType is bare. A crafted value could inject arbitrary Cypher clauses.
findings.impact: Arbitrary graph data read/modification/deletion through crafted entityType.
findings.suggestion: Add runtime allowlist check: const ALLOWED = ['Character','Location','Event']; if (!ALLOWED.includes(entityType)) throw new Error('Invalid entity type');

findings.title: Synchronous fs.readFileSync blocks event loop at module import time
findings.description: loadJson uses fs.readFileSync without error handling. Combined with eager module-level constants in craft-catalog.ts, importing the module triggers synchronous blocking I/O for 5+ JSON files. No try/catch means missing/corrupted files crash at import time.
findings.impact: Blocks Node.js event loop during startup. Missing/corrupted catalog JSON causes unhandled exception at module evaluation. Incompatible with async runtimes (Lambda ESM).
findings.suggestion: Add try/catch with descriptive error including filename. Consider async loading with fs.promises.readFile for future use. At minimum, document the sync trade-off.

findings.title: Module-level const exports force eager catalog loading, defeating lazy caching
findings.description: 18 module-level const exports each call getter functions immediately at module evaluation. Any import of even one symbol triggers all 18 getters, loading all 5 JSON files synchronously. This nullifies the lazy caching in catalog-loader. reloadCatalog() is broken since const bindings cannot be reassigned.
findings.impact: All catalog data loaded at import time regardless of usage. Tree-shaking defeated. reloadCatalog gives false impression of working but const values remain stale.
findings.suggestion: Replace const exports with getter functions or Proxy-based lazy accessors. Remove reloadCatalog or make it work with the new pattern.

findings.title: Circular type dependency between catalog-loader and craft-catalog
findings.description: catalog-loader imports 30+ types from craft-catalog while craft-catalog imports getter functions from catalog-loader. Types should live in the lower layer. This prevents independent compilation, testing, and replacement of either module.
findings.impact: Cannot swap data-loading mechanism without changing type definitions. Adding a new catalog type requires coordinated edits across 4 locations with no compile-time safety.
findings.suggestion: Move enum and interface definitions to a separate craft-types.ts. Both modules import from it, breaking the cycle.

findings.title: Duplicate getter pattern in catalog-loader (20 functions, 3 locations to sync)
findings.description: 20 getter functions follow identical cache-check-and-load pattern. Adding a catalog item requires updating CatalogCache interface, cache initializer, and getter function — 3 locations with no type enforcement. Shared JSON files parsed multiple times due to per-field caching.
findings.impact: Every new catalog item requires 3+ coordinated edits. Per-field caching causes redundant file reads when co-located getters are called sequentially.
findings.suggestion: Replace with generic lazy loader or CatalogCache class with getOrLoad method. Cache at file level rather than field level.

findings.title: SSE parser resets event/data state per chunk, drops cross-chunk events
findings.description: currentEvent and currentData are initialized inside the per-chunk loop. When an SSE event spans chunks, the partial event is lost. Also does not handle multi-line data fields per SSE spec, and drops events without explicit event: line.
findings.impact: Cross-chunk SSE events silently dropped. Multi-line data truncated. Events without event: field ignored.
findings.suggestion: Move currentEvent/currentData outside the while loop. Accumulate multi-line data fields. Default event type to 'message' per SSE spec.

findings.title: Unsafe type assertions on API/SSE response data without runtime validation
findings.description: Multiple locations use 'as T' assertions on parsed JSON/SSE data without runtime checks. readability_score divided by 10 without validation (NaN risk). API response data cast as NonNullable with ad-hoc properties.
findings.impact: Malformed API responses produce NaN scores or undefined values typed as strings, causing unpredictable loop behavior in RevisionOrchestrator.
findings.suggestion: Add runtime type guards at API boundaries. Validate readability_score is finite number before division. Define proper response types for API endpoints.

findings.title: Duplicate SuggestionFocus type and detectSuggestionFocus diverge from canonical source
findings.description: SuggestionFocus union type and detectSuggestionFocus function are duplicated in revisionOrchestrator.ts and suggestionUtils.ts. Keyword mappings can silently diverge, causing inconsistent classification between evaluation UI and revision orchestrator.
findings.impact: Inconsistent focus classification between evaluation UI and revision loop. Adding new focus values requires coordinated changes in two files.
findings.suggestion: Import SuggestionFocus and detectSuggestionFocus from the canonical source (suggestionUtils.ts).

findings.title: API key transmitted in plaintext over HTTP in request body
findings.description: LLM provider API keys included in request body (useEditorAI, WritingHelperPanel) and as URL query parameter (Google API key in models.ts). Vulnerable to network interception on non-TLS connections and server-side log exposure.
findings.impact: API key exposure via network interception, server logs, Referer headers, and browser history.
findings.suggestion: Enforce HTTPS for all API calls. Move API keys to Authorization headers. Route Google model listing through gateway backend instead of direct client-side calls.

findings.title: core.ts re-exports transport functions, violating API/transport layering
findings.description: core.ts both abstracts API calls and re-exports transport-layer functions. Downstream consumers import transport functions from core, creating false dependencies. Some consumers correctly import from transport directly, creating inconsistent import paths.
findings.impact: Transport changes force recompilation of core.ts consumers. Dual import paths for same symbols create maintenance confusion.
findings.suggestion: Stop re-exporting transport from core.ts. Let consumers import from ./transport directly, or create a separate barrel file.

findings.title: core.ts directly imports Sentry, coupling error reporting to API layer
findings.description: API core module directly imports and calls Sentry.captureException. Error reporting is a cross-cutting concern that should not be hardcoded into the API layer. Cannot swap, disable, or configure error reporting without modifying core.ts.
findings.impact: core.ts not independently testable without mocking Sentry. Error reporting strategy changes require API layer modifications.
findings.suggestion: Inject error reporter via callback or interface. callApi should accept optional onError callback. Remove direct Sentry dependency.

findings.title: RevisionOrchestrator.run() is a 188-line method with 7 result construction sites
findings.description: The run() method has high cyclomatic complexity with 7 RevisionResult construction sites. Five construct 'no_improvement' results differing only in revisionSession. Result construction interleaved with control flow obscures the revision loop structure.
findings.impact: High cognitive load. Adding exit conditions or changing result shape requires finding and updating 7 sites. revisionSession reconstructed in 4 locations with potentially conflicting state.
findings.suggestion: Extract buildResult(reason, overrides?) helper. Centralize revisionSession construction in updateRevisionSession method.

findings.title: useEvaluationData useEffect missing qualityGoals dependency
findings.description: useEffect that triggers runEvaluation only depends on [content], but runEvaluation uses qualityGoals. When qualityGoals changes, effect does not re-run, causing stale evaluation results.
findings.impact: Evaluation results become stale when quality goals change. React hooks rule violation.
findings.suggestion: Add qualityGoals to dependency array. Use serialized comparison for object dependencies to avoid reference-identity triggering.

findings.title: Duplicate useEffect with mutually exclusive conditions on backendStatus
findings.description: Two useEffects both watch backendStatus with mutually exclusive conditions (!backendStatus and backendStatus). On state transitions, both callbacks execute. Could cause duplicate loadItems calls.
findings.impact: Duplicate API calls during backendStatus transitions. Confusing pattern that's fragile for edge cases.
findings.suggestion: Merge into single useEffect that calls loadItems() unconditionally on mount and when dependencies change.

findings.title: ExportDialog records wordCount:0 and has hardcoded Chinese i18n strings
findings.description: recordExport always passes 0 for wordCount. Export scope labels ('导出范围', '当前文档', '整个项目') are hardcoded Chinese bypassing the i18n system that the rest of the component uses.
findings.impact: Export history wordCount field is permanently useless. Mixed-language UI when app language is not Chinese.
findings.suggestion: Compute actual word count from editorJson. Add i18n keys for scope labels.

findings.title: Logger production behavior issues: warn silenced, no structured logging, content leakage
findings.description: logger.warn silenced in production (standard practice says warn should be visible). logger.error always active, may leak sensitive data. Content snippet logged in revisionOrchestrator. No log levels beyond dev/prod binary switch. No structured context support.
findings.impact: Production warnings invisible. Error logs may contain user content or infrastructure details. No way to enable selective debug logging in production.
findings.suggestion: Keep warn active in production. Add log level hierarchy with runtime configuration. Never log user content snippets. Remove content.substring from log calls.

findings.title: JSON.stringify search filtering is O(n*size) per render without memoization
findings.description: Search filter serializes each item to JSON string then performs lowercase includes check. No useMemo. Runs on every render, creating GC pressure and lag on keystroke.
findings.impact: Unnecessary CPU work and string allocation per render. Laggy search for 20+ items.
findings.suggestion: Use useMemo to cache filtered results. Match on specific string fields instead of serializing entire objects.

findings.title: RevisionOrchestrator redundant API calls: evaluate called twice per iteration
findings.description: evaluate() called twice per iteration: once for current content (redundant since it was already evaluated at end of previous iteration) and once for revised content. N+1 evaluation pattern wastes API calls.
findings.impact: Each evaluate() is an API round-trip. With maxIterations=5, 11 calls instead of 6 needed.
findings.suggestion: Reuse previous iteration's newEvaluation as currentEvaluation at start of next iteration.

findings.title: SSE chatStream bypasses transport abstraction (raw fetch vs callApi)
findings.description: chatStream uses raw fetch while non-streaming chat uses callApi (which abstracts Tauri invoke vs fetch). SSE path has no Tauri runtime support.
findings.impact: SSE streaming will not work correctly in Tauri desktop environment where backend is accessed through Tauri gateway.
findings.suggestion: Extend transport layer to support streaming. Create callStreamingApi that returns ReadableStream, routing through Tauri events or fetch as appropriate.

findings.title: WritingHelperPanel 30+ inline isZh ternaries bypass i18n system
findings.description: Approximately 30 inline isZh ? '中文' : 'English' ternaries mixed with component logic. Adding a third locale would require rewriting all ternaries. Some strings already use t object, creating inconsistency.
findings.impact: Localization changes require modifying component logic, not translation files. Dual-locale pattern is fragile for multi-language support.
findings.suggestion: Move preset-specific strings to i18n translations object. Consistent with how mode labels are already handled.

findings.title: useExportHistory directly accesses localStorage with empty catch blocks
findings.description: Direct localStorage access without store abstraction, inconsistent with app's Zustand pattern. Empty catch blocks silently swallow errors (violates fix-don't-hide). recordExport re-reads localStorage instead of using current React state.
findings.impact: Export history invisible to app state management. Silent data loss on localStorage failures. In-memory and persisted state can diverge.
findings.suggestion: Integrate into Zustand store with persist middleware. At minimum, log errors using logger instead of empty catch.

findings.title: reloadCatalog() is architecturally broken with const bindings
findings.description: reloadCatalog clears the cache but const bindings cannot be reassigned. After reload, exported constants still hold old values. Function gives false impression of working.
findings.impact: Code calling reloadCatalog expecting fresh data receives stale data. Silent correctness bug.
findings.suggestion: Remove reloadCatalog or replace const bindings with getter-based pattern where reload takes effect on next access.

findings.title: SSE stream error message leaked to user via String(error)
findings.description: Full error converted to string and passed to onError callback. Network errors can contain server hostnames, ports, stack traces, or internal error messages.
findings.impact: Internal infrastructure details leaked to client-side user.
findings.suggestion: Sanitize error messages before passing to callbacks. Use generic message for user, log full error only via logger.error.

findings.title: PersistedEntityTab buildEditorCopy not memoized, cascading useCallback recreations
findings.description: buildEditorCopy called on every render creating new object. Used in useCallback dependency arrays, causing loadItems/handleSave/handleDelete to be recreated every render. Cascading unnecessary re-renders.
findings.impact: Downstream components receiving callbacks as props re-render unnecessarily on every render cycle.
findings.suggestion: Memoize copy object with useMemo depending on itemKind, entityType, itemLabel, language.

findings.title: StoryStructureData uses unbounded string index signature
findings.description: Unlike other catalog types that use enum-constrained Record keys, StoryStructureData uses [key: string] allowing any arbitrary key. No compile-time protection against invalid structure names.
findings.impact: Typos or incorrect keys type-check successfully but return undefined at runtime.
findings.suggestion: Define StoryStructure enum or union type, use Record<StoryStructure, ...> consistent with other catalogs.

findings.title: requestAnimationFrame content buffer stalls when tab is backgrounded
findings.description: RAF callbacks suspended when browser tab backgrounded. Content accumulates in buffer without display. rafScheduled flag never reset, potentially preventing scheduling in subsequent streams.
findings.impact: Backgrounded tabs show no streamed content. On return, large batch appears suddenly. Flag may prevent future scheduling.
findings.suggestion: Add setTimeout fallback when RAF is delayed. Reset rafScheduled unconditionally in flushContentBuffer.

findings.title: SkillTab async CRUD operations lack error handling
findings.description: handleEdit, handleCreate, handleDelete have no try/catch. Network failures leave UI in inconsistent state with no user feedback.
findings.impact: Component may become stuck in editing/creating mode after API errors.
findings.suggestion: Wrap async operations in try/catch, reset state on failure, display error message.

findings.title: Enum-data drift between TypeScript enums and JSON catalog keys
findings.description: Enum values defined in TypeScript must match keys in JSON data files. No compile-time or build-time validation ensures sync. 'as Record<X, XDef>' type assertions bypass structural validation.
findings.impact: Enum-data drift undetectable until runtime. Typo or missing key produces partial catalog with no error.
findings.suggestion: Add runtime validation checking all enum values present as keys in loaded data. Consider generating enums from JSON as build step.

findings.title: SSE content event handler casts data.chunk/data.index without type validation
findings.description: data.chunk cast to string and data.index to number without runtime guards. Malformed SSE events could cause streamer.append to receive non-string values.
findings.impact: Rendering errors or silent failures in editor stream insertion from malformed SSE events.
findings.suggestion: Add runtime type guards: if (typeof data.chunk === 'string') { scheduleContentUpdate(data.chunk, ...) }

findings.title: Export filename not sanitized before use in Tauri desktop context
findings.description: Filename from user input or project name passed directly to download functions. Path separators in filename could potentially be exploited in Tauri environment.
findings.impact: In Tauri desktop context, path traversal in filename could write files to unexpected locations.
findings.suggestion: Strip path separators and null bytes from filename before export operations.

findings.title: useExportHistory ID generation uses Date.now()+Math.random, not collision-safe
findings.description: ID uses millisecond timestamp + 4 base-36 random chars. Low collision risk for manual use, but not guaranteed unique. crypto.randomUUID() available in modern browsers.
findings.impact: Low collision probability for current use case. Not safe for automated/batch scenarios.
findings.suggestion: Use crypto.randomUUID() for guaranteed uniqueness.

findings.title: detectSuggestionFocus keyword-to-enum mapping not documented, hard to extend
findings.description: Focus detection is a chain of string-include checks. Keyword pairs hardcoded and undocumented. focusOrder array in selectNextSuggestion must be kept in sync manually.
findings.impact: Adding focus category requires coordinated edits in two methods with no type-safety enforcement.
findings.suggestion: Extract FOCUS_KEYWORDS data structure deriving both detectSuggestionFocus and focusOrder from single source.

findings.title: selectNextSuggestion sorts full array to pick top item (O(n log n) vs O(n))
findings.description: Creates copy, sorts entire array, takes [0]. A simple reduce or loop would be O(n) and more clearly express 'find best' intent.
findings.impact: Minor performance cost. Primarily a readability issue.
findings.suggestion: Replace with reduce tracking best candidate, making 'find highest-priority' intent explicit.

findings.title: MathView handleBlur deletion condition depends on async attribute update timing
findings.description: Checks node.attrs.latex after updateAttributes call but before attribute update may have taken effect due to React 18 batching. Should check inputValue instead.
findings.impact: Unlikely to cause visible bugs in practice due to timing specifics.
findings.suggestion: Check !inputValue instead of !node.attrs.latex for deletion condition.

findings.title: KaTeX render with throwOnError:false may produce unexpected HTML from crafted LaTeX
findings.description: Any LaTeX input rendered without rejection. Invalid LaTeX rendered as error HTML containing raw input. Large/deeply nested LaTeX could cause performance issues.
findings.impact: Low risk due to KaTeX's safe rendering, but defense-in-depth weakened. Performance DoS via crafted LaTeX possible.
findings.suggestion: Add length limit on LaTeX input (max 10000 chars). Consider throwOnError:true with try/catch and safe fallback.

regression_summary.regression_details: REV-016: Logger production behavior (content leakage via logger.log in revisionOrchestrator) is a Phase 1 regression from the console收口 task — the new logger module enables logging that was previously suppressed, but content snippet logging should have been removed as part of the task.

clusters.root_cause: Data layer (catalog-loader) and API layer (craft-catalog) have circular dependency. Module-level const exports defeat lazy loading. Synchronous I/O blocks event loop. Repetitive getter pattern creates maintenance burden.
clusters.recommended_fix: 1) Extract types to craft-types.ts. 2) Replace const exports with getter functions. 3) Cache at file level. 4) Add error handling to loadJson. 5) Consider async loading path for future use.

spec_compliance.details: All Phase 1 task convergence criteria verified and passed per verification.json. No spec violations found in reviewed code.
